summary: Oriented in the captured OmniPaxos snapshot (core Sequence Paxos decision/authority paths, storage, BLE, and the added async actor layer; existing tests read, none run) and filed the first sourced records: one investigation on whether `append_notify` can report `Ok(assigned_idx)` for an entry dropped by a leader change and replaced at the same index, three knowledge statements (the `drain_notifiers` arm order; assignments carrying only index+ballot with no entry identity; a locally accepted index being unreachable by followers before a write quorum), one necessary gap on reachability of that interleaving, and a question-level source-only Interpretation concluding unresolved with the documented `Superseded` wording and the new-leader adoption rule as counterevidence. No execution this turn: the configured harness target (omnipaxos/tests/assurance_generated.rs in crate `omnipaxos`) cannot link `omnipaxos_runtime`, so the discriminating in-process actor probe still needs a switch to an unprepared crate basis — that build and probe are the unfinished next action. Draft validated (valid, no_change=false, execution_requested=false).
